svg.title: Estonia: the state made restorable, and a target
svg.desc: A diagram of effects for Estonia's cyber posture, drawn as one reinforcing loop with a driver and a grey branch. Occupation memory drives the digitalisation of the state; digitalisation makes the state restorable; the restorable state yields resilience and standing; and that standing funds more digitalisation. The three loop edges run in the same direction, so the loop is reinforcing, marked R and read clockwise, and occupation memory feeds it from outside. Drawn in grey, meaning a sourced effect on a branch with no evidenced return into the loop: the state as a target, the attack surface the same digitalisation raises, so that a breach becomes an attack on the state itself. An increase in the digitalisation of the state raises the restorable state. An increase in the restorable state raises resilience and standing. An increase in resilience and standing raises the digitalisation of the state, by human intervention. An increase in occupation memory raises the digitalisation of the state, by human intervention. An increase in the digitalisation of the state raises the state as a target.
svg.text: Estonia: the state made restorable, and a target
One reinforcing loop of digital statehood, driven by occupation memory, with a grey attack surface it raises
One reinforcing loop, driven by exposure: occupation memory drives the digitalisation of the state, which makes the
state restorable, which yields resilience and standing, which funds more digitalisation.
The grey branch is the cost of the same move: the more the state is data, the more a breach is an attack on the state itself.
natural effect, same direction as the movement of the cause
human intervention, same direction as the movement of the cause
grey: a sourced effect on a branch with no evidenced return
